items.source: A BETTER NEW MIND.
items.target: 一个更美好的全新心智。
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'A BETTER NEW MIND' = mind, not soul

items.source: the power that shall now lead me to my rightful place over the Giants, the Orcs, and Nature itself!
items.target: 这种力量，将会带领我们登上凌驾于巨人、兽人乃至自然本身之上的应有位置！
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'rightful place over the Giants, the Orcs, and Nature itself' = dominance above them, not winning a place back FROM them

items.source: i can't keep stalling the conquest
items.target: 我不能继续拖延征服大业
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'i can't keep stalling the conquest' (panicked inner monologue) = can't keep delaying, not 'can't give up the expedition plan'

items.source: The cracks on Mal'Rok and the other Spellblaze-blasted planets in other systems are still slowly fading
items.target: 玛·洛克以及其他星系里被魔法大爆炸轰击的行星上的裂缝，仍在慢慢消散。
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'The cracks on Mal'Rok and the other Spellblaze-blasted planets' = cracks ON the planets, not cracks surrounding them

items.source: No charge from me - if you accept it, it'll pay for itself.
items.target: 我不收你的钱——只要你愿意用，这笔投入很快就能回本。
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'if you accept it, it'll pay for itself' = the item/deal pays for its own cost, not 'it benefits me a lot'

items.source: we're still losing a few letters going through the mailing system
items.target: 我们的邮递系统仍然会丢失几封信
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'we're still losing a few letters' = a few, not 'large amounts of mail'

items.source: a rotting human hand in a black leather glove, severed at the wrist
items.target: 一只被黑色皮手套包裹的腐烂的人手，手腕被切断了
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'a rotting human hand' = one hand (severed at the wrist, singular), not 'a pair of hands'

items.source: It also committed its lot of atrocities and destructions.
items.target: 你的种族也曾犯下许多暴行，造成无数破坏。
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'It also committed its lot of atrocities and destructions' - old invented '复仇' (revenge), not in source

items.source: All their strongholds in Var'Eyal have been destroyed either by the Sunwall or the one you name the Scourge of the West.
items.target: 你们在瓦·埃亚尔所有的据点不是被太阳堡垒摧毁，就是被你们称作西方灾星的那个人摧毁。
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'destroyed either by the Sunwall or the one you name the Scourge of the West' - old changed either/or to 'and', invented 'almost', dropped 'the one you name'

items.source: the peninsula itself is home to an advanced race of aggressive giants who mastered steam technology
items.target: 半岛本身则居住着一个掌握先进蒸汽科技、充满侵略性的巨人种族
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'an advanced race of aggressive giants who mastered steam technology' - old invented '智慧' (wise/intelligent), not a separate quality in source

items.source: the giants have dug a tunnel through the mountains right into Kruk, pouring out of it to end the Pride once and for all while the bulk of Kruk forces are away
items.target: 巨人从山脉中挖出了一条直通克鲁克的隧道，正从中涌出，要在克鲁克的大部分军队离开时一劳永逸地终结这个部落。
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'pouring out of it to end the Pride... while the bulk of Kruk forces are away' - restores the giants pouring out of the tunnel imagery

items.source: They must be stopped at any cost, if Kruk falls the Orc race dies with it.
items.target: 必须不惜一切代价阻止他们；如果克鲁克沦陷，兽人种族也将随之灭亡。
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'They must be stopped' = stopped/repelled, not '终结' (eliminated/ended)

items.source: highly evolved bipedal animals they still lack true sentience
items.target: 他们仍然缺乏真正的意识
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'lack true sentience' = sentience/consciousness, not '智力' (intelligence)

items.source: transferring their own mind into them to increase the Pride's fighting power
items.target: 将他们自己的意识转移进去来强化部落的战斗力
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'transferring their own mind into them' = mind, not '灵魂' (soul)

items.source: Psionics without a living mind was never thought possible.
items.target: 没有生命心智的灵能从未被认为可能存在。
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'Psionics without a living mind was never thought possible' - old completely changed the subject to 'machine-triggered psionics'

items.source: You have found extremely old machines powered by advanced psionics and technology.
items.target: 你找到了一些由先进灵能与科技驱动的极其古老的机器。
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'extremely old machines' is plural and 'advanced', old said a single plain old machine

items.source: Enter a psionic gestalt with your steam generators, boosting them
items.target: 与你的蒸汽发生器进入灵能格式塔，从而强化它们。
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'Enter a psionic gestalt with your steam generators, boosting them' - 'them' = the generators, not the character

items.source: At this point, it should go without saying that reckless use of magic is a dire threat to...  everything, more or less.
items.target: 说到这里，鲁莽地使用魔法是对……世间一切的可怕威胁，这一点本应不言自明。
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'reckless use of magic is a dire threat to... everything, this should go without saying' - old inverted this into 'we must ABANDON the view that magic is dangerous', contradicting the rest of the passage which argues magic IS dangerous

items.source: Affected by toxic chemicals. Has %d%% talent failure, %d%% reduced healing, and takes %0.2f additional acid damage from melee and ranged attacks.
items.target: 被有毒化学物质影响。 %d%% 技能失败率，降低 %d%% 治疗效果，每回合第一次被带有武器类型的近战或远程攻击命中时，受到额外 %0.2f 酸性伤害。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Miasma=瘴气. The cloud string on the previous key is a different entry and was not changed. EFF_MIASMA.callbackOnHit (timed_effects/physical.lua) returns unless src.turn_procs.weapon_type and not self.turn_procs.miasma, then sets self.turn_procs.miasma and projects acid. T_MIASMA_ENGINE info says the first time each turn a melee or ranged attack hits.

items.source: %d corrosive flechettes are embedded in the target. Each melee and ranged attack against them will cause a flechette to burst for %0.2f acid damage
items.target: 目标体内嵌有 %d 枚腐蚀性毒镖。敌方单位的近战或远程攻击命中目标时，其中一枚毒镖会爆裂，造成 %0.2f 点酸性伤害。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Corrosive Flechette=腐蚀性毒镖. EFF_CORROSIVE_FLECHETTE.callbackOnMeleeHit/callbackOnArcheryHit (timed_effects/physical.lua) burst one flechette and skip if src==self, src dead, self:reactionToward(src)>=0, or src is not an actor. Automated Defenses boltgun (talents/steam/heavy-weapons.lua) applies the effect only when the shield attack hit is true.

items.source: All resistances increased by %d%%, randomly attacks two foes each turn at random.
items.target: 全部抗性提高 %d%%，两把蒸汽枪每回合各自随机选择一名敌人攻击（可能攻击同一目标），持有者被缴械。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Awesome Toss=致命翻转. EFF_AWESOME_TOSS.activate (timed_effects/physical.lua) sets resists.all and disarmed. callbackOnActBase independently rng.table-picks a hostile for main steamgun and offhand steamgun, so both shots may hit the same actor. T_AWESOME_TOSS info says you are disarmed and cannot attack. All Resists terminology is 全部抗性 (resists.all), not 全体抗性.

items.source: The target has been impregnated with %d developing ritch larvae which are feeding on it%s.  After a %d turn gestation period, each will burst out violently, dealing %0.2f physical and %0.2f fire damage to its host.
items.target: 目标被 %d 个里奇幼虫寄生%s。在%d回合的发育期结束后，每个幼虫都会从寄主体内猛烈破体而出，对宿主造成 %0.2f 物理和 %0.2f 火焰伤害；即使效果提前解除，幼虫仍可能以较低强度破体而出并生成幼虫。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Larvae Infestation=里奇幼虫寄生; developing =正在生长的; A %s BURSTS OUT of %s%s. Public source <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/physical.lua EFF_RITCH_LARVA_EGGS.deactivate: if prematurely removed (eff.dur>=0) hatch chance is below 100% and strength is reduced; each larva still rng.percent(chance) may deal moltenrock damage and spawn a ritch larva NPC in an adjacent tile. NPC apply path <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/talents/misc/npcs.lua Ritch Larva Infect sets the effect on a living target after a melee hit.

items.source: Increases steamsaw damage multiplier by %d%%.
items.target: 当前使蒸汽链锯伤害增加 %d%%；每回合首次近战命中指定目标时提高此加成，命中其他敌人则效果结束。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Continuous Butchery=无尽屠戮. Public source <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/physical.lua EFF_CONTINUOUS_BUTCHERY: activate immediately applies current steamsaw_dam_mult from eff.power; callbackOnMeleeAttack miss does nothing, a hit on a different actor removes the effect, and the first successful melee hit each turn on the designated target increases eff.power by power_inc. Combat path <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/superload/mod/class/interface/Combat.lua adds steamsaw_dam_mult/100 only for steamsaw weapons. Talent apply <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/automated-butchery.lua Continuous Butchery sets designated target plus initial/increment for 5 turns.

items.source: Deals %0.2f occult damage per turn and each time a talent is used, the caster regens one turn of a random cooldown.
items.target: 每回合施加者沿至多10格的链接射线，对射线上的生物造成 %0.2f 玄机伤害；施加者不存在或距离超过10格时效果结束且不造成伤害；目标使用非固有技能时，施加者优先随机缩短一个冷却中的科技法术1回合，没有则随机缩短一个冷却中的法术1回合。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Ethereal Steam=虚幻蒸汽; technomancy=科技法术. Public source <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/magical.lua EFF_ETHEREAL_STEAM: callbackOnTalentPost ignores innate talents then randomly reduces one cooling-down is_technomancy talent by 1, else falls back to is_spell; on_timeout removes the effect with no damage if caster missing or distance>10, otherwise projects a range-10 occult beam to the host. Talent apply <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/talents/spells/occult-technomancy.lua Ethereal Steam on hostiles with Congeal Time. Random pick among matching cooldowns is talentCooldownFilter in <MAIN_GAME_ROOT>/game/modules/tome/class/Actor.lua.

items.source: You have %d%% chances to encase your foes in iceblocks.
items.target: 你造成伤害时有 %d%% 几率将敌人封入冰块 3 回合；效果持续期间，冰块吸收的伤害降低 50%。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Algid Rage=寒冰之怒. Public source <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/physical.lua EFF_ALGID_RAGE: callbackOnDealDamage skips already-dead targets then rng.percent(eff.power) applies EFF_FROZEN for 3 turns; activate sets iceblock_pierce to 50. Core combat <MAIN_GAME_ROOT>/game/modules/tome/class/Actor.lua reduces iceblock absorb by iceblock_pierce percent, so 50 means iceblocks absorb 50% less from this actor. Talent apply <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/talents/misc/races.lua Algid Rage for 5 turns.

items.source: Continuously drain blood, dealing %0.2f physical damage per turn and healing the caster for half of it.
items.target: 持续汲取目标的鲜血，每回合造成 %0.2f 点物理伤害；若施加者距离过远、死亡或不在场，链接立即断开且本回合不造成伤害；造成伤害后，施加者获得相当于该伤害一半的治疗，同回合每多一个目标，治疗量在前一目标基础上再减半。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Bloodstar=血液灵晶. Public source <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/physical.lua EFF_BLOODSTAR.on_timeout: if distance to caster >= eff.free, or caster is dead or not on the map, the effect is removed and this turn deals no damage; otherwise physical damage is dealt and caster heals realdam * 0.5^n with n starting at 1 this turn, so first victim heals half and each additional same-turn victim is halved again. Talent apply <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/mechstar.lua Bloodstar.applyOn via Metalstar; eff.free is twice Metalstar radius.

items.source: Storing damage to unleash as a powerful lightning bolt (%d/%d).
items.target: 已格挡伤害可累积至上限，准备放出强力闪电（%d/%d）。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Capacitor Discharge=电力放出; lightning=闪电. Public source <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/other.lua EFF_CAPACITOR_DISCHARGE: long_desc shows current power over max_power; on_merge adds successive power and caps at max_power. Apply path <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/magnetism.lua Capacitor Discharge callbackOnBlock sets power to the actual blocked amount. Damage type is LIGHTNING.

items.source: All stats increased by %d.
items.target: 除力量外的所有属性增加 %d。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Pain Enhancement System=痛苦强化系统; #Target# revels in the pain.=#Target# 在苦痛中狂欢。 EFF_PAIN_ENHANCEMENT_SYSTEM.activate (tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/physical.lua) sets inc_stats only for STAT_DEX/MAG/WIL/CUN/CON; STAT_STR is absent. Granting talent T_PAIN_ENHANCEMENT_SYSTEM info (talents/uber/str.lua) says: increasing all your primary stats except Strength by 50% of your Strength for 6 turns. English key occurs once in pinned Orcs source (this long_desc).

items.source: The target is surrounded by a magical steam shield, absorbing %d/%d damage and burning attackers for %d fire damage before it crumbles.
items.target: 目标被魔法蒸汽护盾包围，吸收 %d/%d 伤害，并在攻击者近战命中时对其造成 %d 点火焰反击伤害。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Steam Shield=蒸汽护盾. Public source <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/magical.lua EFF_STEAM_SHIELD.activate registers on_melee_hit fire damage of eff.retaliate; ranged hits do not trigger. Item apply <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/general/objects/world-artifacts.lua personal steam barrier.

source_evidence.text: 'A BETTER NEW MIND' = mind, not soul
'rightful place over the Giants, the Orcs, and Nature itself' = dominance above them, not winning a place back FROM them
'i can't keep stalling the conquest' (panicked inner monologue) = can't keep delaying, not 'can't give up the expedition plan'
'The cracks on Mal'Rok and the other Spellblaze-blasted planets' = cracks ON the planets, not cracks surrounding them
'if you accept it, it'll pay for itself' = the item/deal pays for its own cost, not 'it benefits me a lot'
'we're still losing a few letters' = a few, not 'large amounts of mail'
'a rotting human hand' = one hand (severed at the wrist, singular), not 'a pair of hands'
'It also committed its lot of atrocities and destructions' - old invented '复仇' (revenge), not in source
'destroyed either by the Sunwall or the one you name the Scourge of the West' - old changed either/or to 'and', invented 'almost', dropped 'the one you name'
'an advanced race of aggressive giants who mastered steam technology' - old invented '智慧' (wise/intelligent), not a separate quality in source
'pouring out of it to end the Pride... while the bulk of Kruk forces are away' - restores the giants pouring out of the tunnel imagery
'They must be stopped' = stopped/repelled, not '终结' (eliminated/ended)
'lack true sentience' = sentience/consciousness, not '智力' (intelligence)
'transferring their own mind into them' = mind, not '灵魂' (soul)
'Psionics without a living mind was never thought possible' - old completely changed the subject to 'machine-triggered psionics'
'extremely old machines' is plural and 'advanced', old said a single plain old machine
'Enter a psionic gestalt with your steam generators, boosting them' - 'them' = the generators, not the character

'reckless use of magic is a dire threat to... everything, this should go without saying' - old inverted this into 'we must ABANDON the view that magic is dangerous', contradicting the rest of the passage which argues magic IS dangerous
